scope: Group appearance and keyboard settings more tightly
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--keyboard-shortcuts-compact.task: Choose appearance and consult keyboard commands in an orderly compact dialog.
conversation--keyboard-shortcuts-compact.observations: All six shortcut labels and keycaps are legible and aligned, with Done visible below. Compact content has been scrolled; cropped preview cards at the upper scroll boundary are expected and the fixed Settings title stays clear. Desktop retains the full two-column dialog.
